contexts.description: Methylation contexts to read from sample H5; default CG only.
contexts.title: Contexts

marker_min_coverage.description: Minimum coverage at a marker CpG for inclusion in Y. Operator-set per profile/site.
marker_min_coverage.title: Marker Min Coverage

min_marker_fraction.description: Minimum fraction of seed markers observed (with coverage) required to emit Ω; below this, proportions are NaN. Operator-set per profile/site.
min_marker_fraction.title: Min Marker Fraction

sample_id_column.description: Column name for sample identifier in cell_fractions.csv.
sample_id_column.title: Sample Id Column

seed_basis_path.description: Path to FlowSorted/IDOL seed basis JSON (markers × cell-type betas). Operator-set per site/profile; defaults to packaged flowsorted_blood_epic_idol_v1.json.
seed_basis_path.title: Seed Basis Path

use_gpu.description: Prefer MethylUtils CuPy/GPU backend when available (honors METHYL_DISABLE_GPU). Operator-set per profile/site; same pattern as centroid use_gpu.
use_gpu.title: Use Gpu
